title: PowerShell vs. WSL Comparison Infographic
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Prompt Engineering / AI Agent Tooling
description: Three-column comparison infographic contrasting PowerShell and WSL as the shell an AI agent uses to automate daily tasks on Windows, with hoverable cells revealing detailed command examples.

learningObjectives: Compare PowerShell and WSL across factors relevant to AI-agent automation on Windows
Explain why AI-generated shell commands run more reliably in WSL than in PowerShell
Identify which shell to reach for depending on the task (general automation vs. Windows-native administration)
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a command-line shell

keyQuestions: Which shell would produce fewer errors if an AI agent ran these commands unsupervised?
When is PowerShell's Windows-native access actually the deciding factor?
commonMisconceptions: PowerShell and bash are just two spellings of the same commands — in practice quoting, aliases, and pipe semantics differ enough to break copy-pasted commands.
assessmentOpportunities: Ask students to predict, before hovering, which shell will have the higher error rate for AI-generated commands and why.
